_readme: Grading and selling fees used by Grading Insights, the card-page calculator and the Intel grading picks. Edit this file when a grader or marketplace changes prices. Money is in cents. Grader tiers: [name, price per card, highest card value the tier covers (null = not published), turnaround in business days], cheapest first, open tiers only. upcharge: true when the grader bills the difference if the graded card is worth more than the tier covers. Selling fees: parts are [percent, applies from, applies up to (null = no limit), fee cap (null = none)], plus a flat fee per order.

PSA.note: PSA's Value tiers have been paused since June 2026, and submitting needs a Collectors Club membership.

CGC.note: Bulk needs 25 or more cards in the order.

BGS.note: Beckett isn't publishing value limits right now; check its submission form for upcharges.

TAG.note: TAG's value limits are insurance limits; it isn't reported to upcharge.
